newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Grenfell units suspend dealing in 3 funds.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell units suspend dealing in 3 funds.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Unit Trust Managers and Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ireland have suspended dealing in three investment funds pending investigation of the value of some of their investments.
A statement from Morgan Grenfell on Monday said the three funds concerned were MG European Growth Trust, MG Europa Fund and MG European Capital Growth Fund.

"The decision to suspend dealing has been reached in conjuction with the Trustees and in consultation with the regulators following the discovery of possible irregularities centring on certain unquoted securities held by the three funds," the statment said.

The fund managers will meet their liabilities in respect of any irregularities identified in the course of the investigations into the funds. Dealings in all other Morgan Grenfell investment funds are not affected.
